package: @astryxdesign/core

# useTooltip

Headless hover/focus tooltip hook. Builds on useLayer w/ hover intent, keyboard focus handling, aria-describedby. Use for custom triggers without wrapper component.

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Use for brief text labels describing icon buttons, truncated text, abbreviations, compact controls.
- **Do:** Prefer Tooltip for standard wrapping; use hook when trigger is not simple child.
- **Do:** Toggle-style trigger: own button calls show()/hide() per press, sets aria-describedby + aria-controls={describedBy}, aria-expanded (true while held), keeps its own name. Info icon: use InfoTip.
- **Don't:** Put interactive content in tooltips: use Popover / HoverCard instead.

## Parameters

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `placement` | `'above' \| 'below' \| 'start' \| 'end'` | `'above'` | position relative to trigger. logical: start/end follow the popover's inherited direction (RTL mirrors). |
| `alignment` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'center'` | alignment along placement axis. logical: start/end follow the popover's inherited direction (RTL mirrors). |
| `delay` | `number` | `200` | show delay in ms. |
| `hideDelay` | `number` | `0` | hide delay after mouse/focus leave in ms. |
| `focusTrigger` | `'auto' \| 'always' \| 'never'` | `'auto'` | when focus opens tooltip; auto = focus on the trigger, or inside a trigger focusable when focus arrives. |
| `touchTrigger` | `'auto' \| 'tap' \| 'none'` | `'auto'` | tap behavior with no hover; auto = tap unless trigger acts, tap = always, none = never. |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | whether hover/focus triggers are enabled. |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` | - | controlled open state: true force-show, false force-hide, undefined unmanaged. |
| `isDefaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | show on mount. |
| `onShow` | `() => void` | - | fires when tooltip becomes visible. |
| `onHide` | `() => void` | - | fires when tooltip hides. |

## Returns

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `ref` | `RefCallback<HTMLElement>` | combined position + interaction ref. |
| `positionRef` | `RefCallback<HTMLElement>` | position anchor ref. |
| `interactionRef` | `RefCallback<HTMLElement>` | hover/focus interaction ref. |
| `anchorId` | `string` | CSS anchor name. |
| `describedBy` | `string` | ID for aria-describedby. |
| `renderTooltip` | `(children: ReactNode, props?: Omit<ContextRenderProps, 'positioning'>) => ReactNode` | renders anchor-positioned tooltip content. |
| `show` | `() => void` | opens + holds until hide()/Escape/outside press/focus leave; announces once; onShow. Controlled: onShow only. No-op when disabled. |
| `hide` | `() => void` | closes; onHide. Controlled: onHide only. |
